summary: Serina Therapeutics filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026, disclosing a Common Stock Purchase Agreement with Roth Principal Investments, LLC. Under the agreement, Serina may, at its sole discretion, sell up to $25,000,000 of newly issued common stock to Roth over a 36-month period, subject to conditions including an effective resale registration statement and a minimum threshold price. This is a standby equity purchase facility (an equity line), not a committed offering, enabling Serina to raise capital opportunistically. No shares are sold at signing; terms like price per share are variable based on market prices at each purchase. The filing also includes a Registration Rights Agreement obligating Serina to file a resale registration statement, and covers unregistered sales of equity securities under Item 3.02. What to watch: actual drawdowns, stock overhang from potential dilution, and the effectiveness of the registration statement.
